subject: business-studies
title: Motivation Stretch Adventure
welcome_lead: Exam-style stretch. Apply motivation theories to real scenarios and evaluate financial vs non-financial rewards.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies stretch — applying motivation theories and weighing financial vs non-financial rewards.
final_note: You can apply theories to scenarios and compare financial vs non-financial motivators.

concepts.def: Extra pay for hitting a target
Adding tasks/skill to make a job meaningful
Perks like gym, healthcare, free meals

walkthroughs.body_html:
Financial rewards fix Maslow's lower needs and Herzberg's hygiene; non-financial rewards drive true motivation.

Most firms use a mix.

Repetitive factory work: piece-rate, bonuses, clear targets (Taylor).

Creative or knowledge work: praise, autonomy, project ownership, job enrichment (Herzberg/Theory Y).

Name the theory → apply to the case → explain the likely effect on productivity, retention or motivation.

Then weigh up the cost vs the benefit before recommending.
